title: Marquee selection
description: A bounded selection rectangle gathers nearby objects with immediate feedback.
useCase: Selecting groups on a design surface or timeline.
interaction: Drag empty space; Shift adds to the selection
reducedMotion: Selection follows input directly; no decorative travel.
limitations: Axis-aligned intersection selection over four fixed shapes, not a freehand polygon lasso or editable canvas.
look: Off-white dotted canvas on a pale sage page with four muted pastel shapes; the selected circle wears a thin green outline and corner handle.
motion: Dragging on empty canvas draws a translucent green rectangle from the press point that tracks the pointer, selecting every shape it intersects live; Shift-drag adds to the existing selection.
adapt: Hit-testing lives in the board's `onPointerDown` and `onPointerMove`: percentage coordinates, an axis-aligned overlap test against `objects`, and `onPointerCancel` restoring `previous`. Replace `objects` with your items' bounds and restyle `.sf-lassoselect-marquee`.
